reports.title: Bittensor Subnet Inflection, Filecoin Re-rating, Injective EVM Catalyst
reports.summary: Three structural themes are converging: AI compute demand continues to exceed supply, on-chain RWA distribution is entering the institutional phase, and modular L2s with credible DA economics are winning wallet share.

market_overview.key_macro: Strong US jobs data + cooling inflation prints — risk-on regime extending into Q3. Crypto has decoupled from NASDAQ correlation this week; idiosyncratic narrative is back in control.

top_opportunities.thesis: Subnet expansion is now demonstrably working. dTAO emissions rebalancing increased network efficiency 18%. Buy pullbacks to 30-day MA.
Apple Vision Pro partnership expanded node utilization +24%. Real revenue, real customers. Pullback to 50-day MA is the highest-quality re-entry in DePIN.
BlackRock BUIDL integration completed. USDY APY exceeded 5.0% — a multi-year high. Institutional RWA distribution at an inflection.

most_active_developers.comment: Subnet tooling maturity is now the main driver of new dev inflow.
EVM compatibility opened the door for EVM-native dev teams.
Steady core team activity; new Filecoin Plus SDKs released.
Base migration layer added new contributor teams.

biggest_ecosystem_growth.comment: Subnets continue to be the dominant growth axis.
Quality of nodes increasing as professional studios onboard.
H100 launch was a real demand catalyst.
BlackRock integration is the most cited reason for new inflows.

new_partnerships.summary: Joint go-to-market for enterprise AI compute customers.

investment_rounds.comment: Ecosystem fund to accelerate enterprise onboarding.

upcoming_unlocks.comment: 12-month linear release softens impact but supply pressure remains.
Largest unlock of the quarter — watch for short-term pressure.

risk_alerts.alert: Token unlock in 18 days — 1.13% of supply. Watch for distribution-to-exchange ratio in T-7 days.
Developer activity down 14% MoM. If trend continues into Q3, AI Score will drop below 70.
Sequencer revenue -22% vs 30d average. May indicate transaction migration to Base.
Q4 2026 unlock cliff — 7.2% of total supply. Long-term holder distribution risk.

reports.ai_conclusions: Three structural themes remain intact: (1) AI compute demand continues to exceed supply — TAO, RENDER, AKT, IO are all evidence; (2) on-chain RWA distribution is entering the institutional phase, led by ONDO and Maple; (3) modular L2s with credible DA economics (TIA, MANTA) are winning wallet share. Risk to monitor: token unlock velocity in Q3 2026 for ARB, MANTA, SUI. Sector rotation likely continues — AI infrastructure stays primary overweight.

reports.title: Q3 Outlook: AI Compute Re-rating, RWA Inflection, and the Coming Unlock Cycle
reports.summary: We are upgrading our base case for AI infrastructure through Q3 2026. DePIN remains the highest-quality real-yield exposure. Token unlock velocity is the main risk to monitor.

market_overview.key_macro: Risk-on regime reasserting itself. Crypto market cap crossed $2.3T with relatively low retail engagement — institutional accumulation is the dominant signal.

top_opportunities.thesis: Subnet inflection is the cleanest narrative in AI infrastructure. Network revenue and dev activity both inflecting.
Real revenue, real customers, defensible moat. Highest-quality DePIN exposure.
Institutional RWA distribution. BlackRock integration is the most credible TradFi bridge.

most_active_developers.comment: Subnets continue to attract dev inflow.
EVM compatibility opened EVM-native dev teams.
Base migration layer added new contributor teams.
Agent launchpad is creating new dev teams.

biggest_ecosystem_growth.comment: Subnets continue to be the dominant growth axis.

upcoming_unlocks.comment: Largest single unlock of the quarter.

reports.ai_conclusions: Q3 2026 thesis: AI infrastructure overweight, DePIN overweight, RWA overweight, L2s neutral, GameFi underweight. Main risk: ARB and SUI unlock cycles. Watch for entry points in TAO, RENDER, ONDO on any meaningful pullback.

reports.title: Render Enterprise Tier, Celestia Modular DA, and the Quiet RWA Acceleration
reports.summary: Three underappreciated themes: Render's enterprise SLA tier is winning institutional customers, Celestia's DA revenue is the most under-modeled line item, and RWA TVL crossed $24B for the first time.

market_overview.key_macro: Consolidation phase. Low retail engagement, institutional accumulation continuing. Vol compressing — typical pre-breakout structure.

top_opportunities.thesis: Enterprise SLA tier winning institutional customers. Real revenue inflection.
DA revenue is the most under-modeled line item in the modular thesis.
RWA TVL crossed $24B. ONDO remains highest-quality RWA exposure.

most_active_developers.comment: Enterprise tier brought new B2B dev teams.

biggest_ecosystem_growth.comment: Blob fees starting to be meaningful.

upcoming_unlocks.comment: Largest single unlock of the quarter.

reports.ai_conclusions: Quiet market — but institutional RWA and AI compute are still inflecting. Stay overweight AI infrastructure and DePIN. Use the consolidation to accumulate high-conviction positions.
